tagline: AI-narrated interactive stories — _one engine_, shipped on Android, iOS & the web.
pitch: {product} is Kuku FM's AI interactive-fiction app. Step into an authored, multi-act story or chat with a character — a language model narrates every turn live while you steer with options or your own words.
summary: I made the first commit — the playable MVP — and have led the build since: one Python backend behind a web app, a native Android app, a native iOS app and an internal authoring studio. I also own releases, from Play and App Store uploads to production deploys.

chapters.title: AI Story Engine
chapters.summary: From a week-one playable MVP to a spec-driven engine where code keeps score and the model only tells the story.
bullets: Turned a numbered spec set into a working engine — act schema, validation gate, act planner, deterministic orchestrator — on one rule: if the same input must give the same output, it's code, not a prompt.
Kept play true to canon: only the current act's canon reaches the model, and an act can't close until its key story beats have happened.
Cut warm-turn latency ~2.5x: safety runs in parallel with generation, narration streams token by token out of the model's JSON, and prompts are ordered for provider prefix caching.
Added a calibrated decision-model API beside the LLM to double-check act-completion and beat claims and to screen junk input without charging the player — every call fails soft.

chapters.title: Native Android
chapters.summary: A native Jetpack Compose app on the shared backend — live on Google Play.
bullets: Built the Android app in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on the shared backend: streaming chat, Google sign-in through Credential Manager, Google Play Billing.
Shipped ~20 Play releases (latest 1.0.21) on R8-optimised release builds, covered by ~38 unit-test files.
Built the re-engagement loop: 24h and 72h return reminders on WorkManager with copy from a team-edited Google Sheet, plus FCM push campaigns.
Added promo deep links that open a show's chat straight from an ad.

chapters.title: Native iOS
chapters.summary: Sole author of the iOS app — blank SwiftUI scaffold to App Store submission in ~12 days.
bullets: Wrote the iOS app end to end and brought it to full feature parity with Android before submitting it to the App Store.
Wired StoreKit 2 with server-side verification, account-bound purchases and App Store refund notifications.
Shipped the platform extras: Sign in with Apple, Live Activities on the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen, universal links and push.
Covered the store requirements — in-app account deletion, report-a-reply, a privacy manifest, App Tracking Transparency — backed by ~33 test files.

chapters.title: Web App
chapters.summary: The React web client — sign-in, coin store and live streaming chat in the browser.
bullets: Built Firebase email and Google sign-in with a redirect fallback.
Built the web coin store on Razorpay Checkout, on the same coin ledger as the apps.
Rendered narration as it streams, with a frame-timed scroll-follow implemented identically on web, Android and iOS.

chapters.title: Payments & Coins
chapters.summary: Three payment rails behind one coin ledger — every purchase verified on the server.
bullets: Put Razorpay, Google Play Billing and StoreKit 2 behind one coin ledger, each with its refund path: dispute and chargeback clawback, real-time Play refund notifications, App Store refund notifications.
Built the coin economy: separate paid and promotional balances and a guarded order state machine — success, disputed, refunded.
Made coin spending atomic, priced coins from live exchange rates instead of hard-coded numbers, and issued tax-invoice PDFs.

chapters.title: Growth & Attribution
chapters.summary: Server-side attribution and funnel tooling, so every purchase and drop-off can be measured.
bullets: Reported purchases from the server — Meta Conversions API and AppsFlyer server-to-server events, enriched with the advertising ID so they reach ad platforms.

Diagnosed an analytics bug dropping session IDs from a large share of Android events with BigQuery and clean-device A/B tests, then shipped a custom session ID across web, Android, iOS and the server.
Built funnel tooling: per-show card impression and click-through tracking on all three clients, act-completion events, and a Meta ad-spend import for ROAS.

chapters.title: Authoring Studio
chapters.summary: An admin studio where “Split with AI” turns a pasted script or PDF into a structured, multi-act story.
bullets: Built “Split with AI”: a four-stage pipeline — intake → extract → build → append — from raw script to structured story.
Extracted long scripts act by act, so there is no act cap and no timeouts, and tracked LLM cost per show.
Made pictures safe to edit: versioned saves, saves that would strip pictures refused until confirmed, a restorable picture history, and S3 reorganised per show and per character.
Wrote a structural portrait-name resolver, so character portraits survive shortened names — and never show the wrong character.

chapters.title: Safety & Hardening
chapters.summary: Every input checked before a word is shown; admin endpoints locked down after a four-repo review.
bullets: Ran every player input through a safety classifier before any story text is shown, with a structural character age gate and reply reporting.
Hardened the platform: locked-down admin endpoints, per-IP rate limiting, a Firebase ID token on every API call and OIDC-authenticated Play notifications.
Enforced a hash-based Content Security Policy with violation reporting on the web app.
Shipped finance-safe self-service account deletion on every client and email verification with 6-digit codes over AWS SES.
